content: There are currently no well-established risk factors identified for OR. The most significant risk factor contributing to the development of OR remains undefined. Other potential risk factors may include various elements, though they are not conclusively established. Common risk factors associated with the development of certain conditions may include occupational exposures, environmental influences, genetic predispositions, and viral factors. While no definitive risk factors for OR have been determined, these broader categories of risk factors are often considered in related contexts.
